reason: Generates three context-aware follow-up questions after each agent response and presents them as editable or clickable chat actions.

summaries.zh: 在每次智能体回答后，根据近期对话生成三个可编辑或可点击发送的后续问题建议。
summaries.en: Generates three context-aware follow-up question suggestions after each agent response, with options to edit or send them.

capabilities: Reads recent conversation messages to form context
Calls an LLM to generate three follow-up question suggestions
Renders editable suggestions in the chat interface
Submits a selected suggestion as a new chat turn when clicked
Caches suggestions by conversation and turn
